g.text: Source: GitHub API. Days are UTC; faded marks are today so far.
Queue wait is sampled from 5% of each day's runs (at least 30); runner time is runner occupancy where its readings cover the day, else that sample's estimate (± 95%).
promoter-bot = PRs from churn/, agy/ branches. Other agents = agent branch prefixes or PR-body markers. Failed % is per workflow run, not per PR; minutes saved is estimated.
